description: Whole-library housekeeping for Jellyfin covering movies, TV, music, audiobooks, books and comics. Finds duplicates, broken files, oversized encodes, unwanted or missing language tracks, misplaced files, ungrouped media, corrupt artwork, suspicious executables, orphaned metadata, stale content and space-heavy trickplay — then fixes them safely. Dry-run mode and a recycle bin protect your media by default.
name: MediaDash
